title: Moonwater Temple — The Evening Bell
description: An autumn Buddhist sanctuary: vermilion three-storey pagoda with nine-ring sorin, irimoya worship hall and golden altar, suspended evening bell, and a smoothly arched red moon bridge across a koi-and-lotus pond. Compact local foundations preserve the raked court and autumn islands; continuous eave supports and long timber posts connect the architecture.
